lines.zh: 我的翅膀一扇，草全伏下。
lines.en: One wingbeat and the grass lies flat.
My huge shadow sweeps over the flower field.
I fly low so I do not break the hive.

lines.zh: 落下来时地面闷响一声。
lines.en: The ground thuds dully when I land.
I crawl slowly over the beeswax.
My wings are so wide I turn in long arcs.

lines.zh: 我沿着结构的外墙盘旋。
lines.en: I circle along the outside wall of the structure.

lines.zh: 花粉在我身下像雪落下。
lines.en: Pollen falls beneath me like snow.
Every wingbeat stirs up wind.
I fly past the hive and the bees make way.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住半个蜂巢。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the hive.
I perch on a branch and it creaks loudly.

lines.zh: 这么重的身体也能悬停。
lines.en: Even this heavy, I can hover in place.
I glide slowly down from the tower top.
I skim along the honeywax wall.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇出的风，推着花粉走。
lines.en: My wingbeat pushes the pollen along.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根巨大的巢柱。
lines.en: I bank around a huge comb pillar.
Landing, my six legs take the weight.
I lie on the wax and rest my wings.
The smell of honey makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我慢慢梳着腹部的绒毛。
lines.en: I slowly groom the fuzz on my belly.

lines.zh: 整片花田都在我视野里。
lines.en: The whole flower field lies within my view.
Wind passes through my wings and I squint.

lines.zh: 有只小蜜蜂停在我背上。
lines.en: A little bee lands on my back.
I rest my head on my front legs.

lines.zh: 偶尔有蜜蜂来蹭我的腿。
lines.en: Now and then a bee nuzzles my leg.
I count the flowers blooming in the distance.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，安静得反常。
lines.en: A body this big is oddly quiet.

lines.zh: 我在等谁提着蜂蜜桶来。
lines.en: I wait for someone to come with a honey bucket.

lines.zh: 翅膀收起来有一扇门大。
lines.en: Folded, my wings are as big as a door.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候，我低头。
lines.en: When you look up, I look down.
You have lifted the bucket of honey.
I know the smell of that bucket.
You stand firm; you do not seem afraid.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶悬停了一会儿。
lines.en: I hover above your head for a while.
Where did you put my saddle?
I lower an antenna and touch you.

lines.zh: 你身上有我熟悉的蜜香。
lines.en: You carry a honey scent I know well.
You reach out, so I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 这么大的个子，你也敢摸。
lines.en: I am this big, and still you dare to pet me.

lines.zh: 我在看你是不是带了蜂蜜。
lines.en: I am checking whether you brought honey.

lines.zh: 你正好站在我的复眼中间。
lines.en: You're standing right between my compound eyes.

lines.zh: 我眨眼很慢，别以为是困。
lines.en: I blink slowly; do not mistake it for sleep.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我就低一点。
lines.en: You step closer, so I lower myself.
You broke one of my wing veins.
My friendliness has dropped again.
That hit knocked me off course.

lines.zh: 我身上的绒毛焦了一片。
lines.en: A patch of my fuzz is singed.
I will remember, but I will not hold a grudge.
The pain makes my wings lag half a beat.
You had better not add a second hit.
I land and steady myself.

lines.zh: 这么厚的甲也扛不住剑。
lines.en: Even this thick hide cannot take a blade.
My saddle has been knocked crooked.
A bucket of honey; I see it.
Hold it higher; I cannot reach.
One taste of that and I follow you.
A honey bottle works too; I am not picky.
The moment sweetness appears, my legs weaken.
Set the bucket down and I will drink slowly.
The way you shake that bucket, you understand me.
Bring another bucket; I am not full.

lines.zh: 我认这个味道，认了很久。
lines.en: I have known this taste for a long time.
I do not bite the one who feeds me.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的绒毛，被弹开。
lines.en: You hit my fuzz and bounce off.

lines.zh: 我落地的震动把你掀了。
lines.en: The shake of my landing knocks you over.
Do not stand where I take off.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扫过你的帽子。
lines.en: My wing sweeps across your hat.

lines.zh: 你这么小，撞上来像挠痒。
lines.en: You are so small your bump feels like a scratch.
I shift a foot to let you pass.
You push me and I do not even sway.

lines.zh: 撞到我的绒毛，你一身黄。
lines.en: You hit my fuzz and turn all yellow.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一收，把你夹了下。
lines.en: I fold my wings and pinch you a little.
Sorry, my size does not fold away.

lines.zh: 这么大的巢，只住我一个。
lines.en: A hive this large houses only me.
I am waiting for another beehemoth.
My wings will pass to my young.
The field is big enough to raise a family.
You are interrupting me.
Beehemoths are scarce in the Bumblezone.

lines.zh: 我们绕着对方飞了一圈。
lines.en: We circle each other once in the air.
This season is not quite right.

lines.zh: 我的友好度还没到那步。
lines.en: My friendliness has not reached that point.
Let me eat my fill first.
That bucket of honey is mine now.
I lower my head and take the flower.
There is a honeycomb on the ground; I take it.

lines.zh: 这么点东西，我一口就没。
lines.en: That little thing is gone in one bite.
I scoop up that bucket with my front legs.
A dropped saddle; I recognize it.

lines.zh: 我把花枝连根拔了起来。
lines.en: I pull the flower up roots and all.

lines.zh: 我的爪子太粗，捏碎了一点。
lines.en: My claws are so thick they crush a little.
This drop of honey fell by my feet.
It is mine; do not grab.
You took the honey bucket away.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从背后摸。
lines.en: I dislike being touched from behind.
Someone is poking my wing.
That last move did not count as feeding.
My antennae have turned toward you.
My friendliness just dropped a notch.
I have remembered your hand.
This is not the time to beg for honey.
You have annoyed a beehemoth.

lines.zh: 蜂鸣声先替我打了招呼。
lines.en: My drone announces me before I turn.
I rise to the height above your head.
My wings beat faster and faster.

lines.zh: 翅膀的风压低了整片草。
lines.en: The wind from my wings flattens the whole meadow.
You back away, so I drop lower.

lines.zh: 翅膀停在半空，我盯着你。
lines.en: Hovering, I stare down at you.
This charge will land very heavily.
The swarm watches from a distance.
I have adjusted my angle.
Hand over that bucket of honey.
An apology would still work now.
I ram you and you go flying.
My wings beat you off your feet.
My foreleg comes down and cracks the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整只巨蜂的力。
lines.en: This blow carries the weight of a whole beehemoth.
You are flipped into the flower field.
My stinger sweeps out a gust of wind.
You block it, but give up three steps.
My weight is the weapon.
The swarm charges in behind me.
Do not take it head on; you cannot.

lines.zh: 我从花田上空缓缓落下。
lines.en: I descend slowly over the flower field.

lines.zh: 这只巨蜂出生在蜜蜂领域。
lines.en: This beehemoth was born in the Bumblezone.
The wax splits and I squeeze out.

lines.zh: 周围的小蜜蜂都抬头看我。
lines.en: The little bees around me all look up.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一展开就遮住阳光。
lines.en: My wings spread and block the sunlight.

lines.zh: 这个结构里居然有巨蜂。
lines.en: A beehemoth, inside this structure.

lines.zh: 蜂巢不够大，我睡在外面。
lines.en: The hive is too small, so I sleep outside.

lines.zh: 我是这片花田里最大的一只。
lines.en: I am the largest thing in this flower field.
The wind carried me here from far away.

lines.zh: 我落在尖塔旁的平台上。
lines.en: I land on the platform beside the spire.
My first wingbeat fills the air with pollen.

lines.zh: 蜂群给我让出一片空地。
lines.en: The swarm clears an open space for me.
Fire shrivels the membrane of my wing.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，地面凹了。
lines.en: I crash down and dent the ground.
I fall into a honey pool and stick all over.
The blast rolls me over in the air.
An arrow pierces the strap of my saddle.
Magic stiffens my wings.

lines.zh: 太久没喝蜜，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Too long without honey and I cannot lift off.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，麻到翅尖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and numbs my wingtips.

lines.zh: 虚空拽着我的翅膀往下沉。
lines.en: The void pulls my wings downward.
